modules.name: Insulated Container Shell and Bund
modules.purpose: Provides the structural ISO 40-foot High-Cube envelope, thermal insulation, hygienic internal lining, and watertight floor bund that houses all internal subsystems and resists road-transport loads.

modules.name: Port-Side Multi-Tier Grow Rack
modules.purpose: Holds plant sites across multiple hydroponic tiers on the port side of the centre aisle, supporting channels, root zones, and integrated lighting rails.

modules.name: Starboard-Side Multi-Tier Grow Rack
modules.purpose: Mirror counterpart of the port rack, holding plant sites on the starboard side of the centre aisle with identical tier and channel geometry.

modules.name: LED Lighting Array and Drivers
modules.purpose: Delivers full-spectrum photosynthetic light to all tiers under daily light integral control, with centralised drivers in the service end.

modules.name: Climate Control and Carbon-Dioxide Dosing Unit
modules.purpose: Maintains internal air temperature, humidity, circulation, and carbon-dioxide concentration via a ducted air-handling unit, dehumidifier, in-canopy fans, and bottled carbon-dioxide dosing manifold.

modules.name: Recirculating Nutrient and Water System
modules.purpose: Stores, doses, filters, sterilises, and circulates hydroponic nutrient solution between the central reservoir and grow rack channels with pH and electrical conductivity control.

modules.name: Electrical Power Distribution
modules.purpose: Receives the external three-phase mains supply and distributes protected, metered power to lighting, climate, nutrient, and control loads via the main distribution board.

modules.name: Controls, Sensor Mesh, and Internet-of-Things Gateway
modules.purpose: Hosts the programmable logic controller, distributed environmental and process sensors, and cloud uplink that orchestrate all subsystems and report to the remote farm-management dashboard.

modules.name: Service Vestibule and Workstation
modules.purpose: Provides the door-end work area for transplanting, propagation, hand-washing, and human access to control cabinets, carbon-dioxide bottles, and reservoir service points.

modules.name: Hardwood Handle Assembly
modules.purpose: Machined ash or walnut handle housing the user interface transducers, grip sensor, and inertial measurement unit, providing the primary hand contact and acoustic chamber.

modules.name: Upper Carbon-Fibre Shaft Assembly
modules.purpose: Twenty-two millimetre outer diameter upper carbon-fibre tube containing the tubular electronics cavity, antenna radio-frequency window, and inductive charging receiver coil.

modules.name: Lower Carbon-Fibre Shaft and Adjustment Mechanism
modules.purpose: Nineteen millimetre outer diameter lower telescoping shaft with spring-loaded pin-clip length adjustment, transferring axial load between handle and ferrule.

modules.name: Rubber and Tungsten-Carbide Ferrule Assembly
modules.purpose: Replaceable ground-contact tip with tungsten-carbide insert in moulded rubber body, instrumented with a pressure sensor for ground-contact and gait-cycle detection.

modules.name: Main Electronics and Connectivity Module
modules.purpose: Long, narrow printed circuit board carrying the Nordic nRF9160 cellular module, embedded subscriber identity module, neural co-processor, global positioning system receiver, antennas, and impact accelerometer for sensing, compute, and cellular communication.

modules.name: Battery and Inductive Charging Receiver Module
modules.purpose: Custom cylindrical lithium-polymer cell, charge controller, and protection circuitry providing two-week runtime and managing inductive charging.

modules.name: Inductive Charging Stand
modules.purpose: Floor-standing front-door dock containing the inductive transmit coil and mains power supply, cradling the stick to maintain the three-to-six millimetre coupling air-gap.

modules.name: Outer Body and Structural Chassis
modules.purpose: Ceramic or powder-coated steel weatherproof enclosure that houses all internal modules, mounts the solar panel and reservoirs, and provides the radome aperture for radios.

modules.name: Solar Panel, Battery and Power Management Subsystem
modules.purpose: Captures solar energy, stores it in a lithium iron phosphate battery, and regulates power rails for all electronic modules; supports an optional mains-powered variant.

modules.name: Compute and Inference Module
modules.purpose: Main printed circuit board assembly carrying the neural processing unit system-on-chip, memory and storage, running on-device species and individual identification and video clipping.

modules.name: Camera and Environmental Sensor Module
modules.purpose: Provides the 12-megapixel optical-zoom camera, microphone, and temperature, light and weather sensors with their weatherproof apertures and acoustic ports.

modules.name: Perch and Weight Sensing Assembly
modules.purpose: Mechanically isolated perch with integrated load cell that measures individual bird mass for identification.

modules.name: Modular Seed Reservoir Assembly
modules.purpose: Interchangeable nyjer, sunflower and suet ball reservoirs that attach to the body via a common mechanical interface and gravity-feed seed to the feeding zone.

modules.name: Wireless Connectivity Module
modules.purpose: Pre-certified Wi-Fi and Bluetooth Low Energy radio with optional cellular and LoRa mesh radios, providing antenna isolation and uplink to home network, cellular network and neighbouring feeders.

modules.name: Container Enclosure and Structural Frame
modules.purpose: Provides the ISO 1496-1 compliant 40-foot High Cube weatherproof, fire-rated, transportable shell that houses and structurally supports all internal sub-assemblies and anchors to the concrete pad via ISO 1161 corner castings.

modules.name: Lithium Iron Phosphate Battery Rack Assembly
modules.purpose: Stores 3.5 megawatt-hours of electrical energy in lithium iron phosphate cell modules arranged in floor-mounted racks along both long walls of the container.

modules.name: Bi-directional Grid-Forming Power Conversion System
modules.purpose: Converts between direct current battery power and 1.5 megawatt three-phase alternating current with grid-forming capability, compliant with United Kingdom G99 grid code, and routes alternating current to the external gland plate.

modules.name: Liquid Cooling Skid
modules.purpose: Maintains battery and power electronics within operating temperature range using a glycol-water liquid loop with an externally serviceable chiller mounted on the roof or end wall.

modules.name: Battery Management System
modules.purpose: Distributed cell, rack, and system-level monitoring and protection electronics that manage state of charge, balancing, isolation, and thermal limits per IEC 62619 and IEC 63056.

modules.name: Fire Detection and Suppression System
modules.purpose: Provides off-gas, smoke, and heat detection together with gas-based suppression and deflagration venting aligned to National Fire Chiefs Council guidance and NFPA 855.

modules.name: Auxiliary Power and Low-Voltage Distribution
modules.purpose: Provides uninterruptible low-voltage power, distribution, and protection to all internal sub-assemblies including controls, battery management, cooling, and fire safety.

modules.name: Controls and Supervisory Cabinet
modules.purpose: Houses the system-level controller, supervisory control and data acquisition gateway, and communications interfaces that orchestrate dispatch, protection coordination, and remote monitoring.

modules.name: Container and Skid Structure
modules.purpose: Provides the 40-foot ISO shipping container enclosure, internal base skid, service aisle, and wall penetrations that house and mechanically support all process modules during transport and operation.

modules.name: Seawater Pre-treatment Module
modules.purpose: Conditions raw seawater feed via multimedia filtration, 5 micrometre cartridge filtration, antiscalant dosing and dechlorination to protect downstream reverse osmosis membranes.

modules.name: High Pressure Pump and Energy Recovery Device Assembly
modules.purpose: Boosts filtered feedwater to seawater reverse osmosis operating pressure while recovering hydraulic energy from the brine stream via an isobaric pressure exchanger to meet the specific energy consumption target.

modules.name: First Pass Seawater Reverse Osmosis Train
modules.purpose: Separates fresh permeate from pressurised seawater feed across an array of eight inch fibreglass pressure vessels containing seawater reverse osmosis membrane elements at fifty per cent recovery.

modules.name: Second Pass Brackish Water Reverse Osmosis Train
modules.purpose: Polishes first pass permeate through a brackish water reverse osmosis stage at ten to twenty bar to deliver permeate meeting World Health Organization drinking water guidelines.

modules.name: Post-treatment Module
modules.purpose: Remineralises permeate through a calcite contactor with carbon dioxide dosing and disinfects with sodium hypochlorite to produce stable potable water meeting NSF/ANSI 61 wetted component requirements.

modules.name: Clean-in-Place System
modules.purpose: Provides a polyethylene tank, circulation pump and chemical injection points to periodically flush and clean the reverse osmosis membranes without disassembly.

modules.name: Motor Control Centre and Power Distribution Cabinet
modules.purpose: Receives external three phase mains or diesel genset supply and distributes filtered, protected three phase and low voltage power to the high pressure pump motor and all auxiliary electrical loads.

modules.name: Programmable Logic Controller and Instrumentation Cabinet
modules.purpose: Executes process automation, monitors pressures, flows, conductivity and tank levels, and provides operator interface for startup, shutdown, alarms and remote telemetry.

scores.summary: A well-structured 9-module decomposition with clear functional separation, good parts coverage, and engineering-appropriate naming, but the total mass rollup (~6495 kg) sits at the low end of plausibility for a fully fitted 40 ft HC container, fire safety and emergency systems are absent, and the port/starboard rack split is a minor structural duplication that could be collapsed.
scores.nextFix: Add a Fire Detection, Suppression, and Emergency Shutdown module — a regulatory and insurance requirement for UK containerised farms that is entirely absent and will block downstream compliance review.

scores.summary: Structurally coherent 7-module decomposition with clear naming and good mechanical/electronic separation, but critically undermined by zero key parts across all modules, a mass rollup that sums to ~2.58 kg against a 0.45 kg target (dominated by the 2.20 kg charging stand skewing the stick itself), and missing firmware/software, audio/haptic transducer, and barometric sensor sub-systems.
scores.nextFix: Populate every module with ≥3 specific key parts (e.g. Nordic nRF9160 SiP, u-blox M10 GPS, 600 mAh cylindrical LiPo cell) — zero key-parts coverage is the single largest downstream blocker for BOM, cost, and supplier matching.

scores.summary: Solid 7-module decomposition covering the core IoT+optics+power stack with good part counts, but misses a dedicated user-interface/connectivity-indicator module, the perch wiring harness integration is ambiguous, and the 3.78 kg total sits at the low end of plausible for a ceramic/steel premium enclosure.
scores.nextFix: Add an explicit Mechanical Fastening, Sealing and Weatherproofing sub-system (gaskets, IP-rated cable glands, stainless fixings, anti-corrosion coatings) currently buried invisibly inside Module 1, and split the Camera module's environmental sensors into a dedicated Weather and Environmental Sensor Module to reduce functional crowding in Module 4.

scores.summary: A well-structured 8-module decomposition covering all major BESS sub-systems with clear functional separation, good naming specificity, and adequate key-parts depth; the only notable concern is the total mass rollup of ~30,610 kg sitting at the low end of the expected 30–40 t gross range for a fully loaded 40 ft HC container, and the BMS/Controls split risks minor interface ambiguity.
scores.nextFix: Validate and reconcile the mass rollup: the 22,000 kg battery rack figure implies roughly 6.3 kg/kWh at cell level which is plausible for LFP, but add estimated masses for cabling, coolant charge, and ancillary steelwork to confirm the gross vehicle weight stays within the 40 t flatbed limit and matches the container tare + payload budget.

scores.summary: Functionally well-structured 9-module decomposition with clear separation of concerns, but critically undermined by zero key parts across all modules, a missing mass entry for the MCC cabinet, a total mass rollup (~7965 kg without MCC) that sits at the low end of plausibility for a fully equipped 40-ft containerised SWRO unit, and absent sub-systems for product water storage/transfer and chemical dosing storage.
scores.nextFix: Populate every module with at least 3 key parts (e.g. pressure vessels, membrane elements, pump model, VFD, pressure exchanger make/model) — key_parts_coverage is 0/10 and is the single largest score drag affecting all downstream BOM, cost, and supplier-matching stages.
